items.summary: Cognition before 0.13.0 defaults its agent sandbox backend to local execution and ships no authentication on its REST/SSE API, letting unauthenticated attackers run arbitrary shell commands as the server process.
Vanus 0.8.0 through 0.9.0 ships a hardcoded admin token, letting unauthenticated remote attackers gain cluster-admin access over the gateway gRPC proxy and manage namespaces, users, and events.

Rank Math SEO PRO suffered a supply-chain compromise: a subset of version 3.0.123 packages downloaded or updated between Oct 15 20:02 UTC and Oct 16 07:12 UTC contained malware — reinstall clean packages now.

An authentication bypass in BeyondTrust Remote Support lets unauthenticated remote attackers perform file operations on the appliance; CISA added it to the KEV catalog on Oct 16 amid confirmed active exploitation.

Google's OSS Agent Mesh (SAM) 0.1.0-alpha.1 through alpha.8 lets a remote attacker self-enroll into the mesh and invoke arbitrary tools across connected MCP backends due to missing authorization and insecure defaults.
